text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

The panel's composition doesn't point anywhere useful for you. You're a man, the panel were men, and the person appointed is a man — an all-male panel is the least likely configuration to have disadvantaged you on grounds of sex. Raising it would read as grasping, and would weaken the parts of your case that are actually solid.

What's solid: you have fifteen years to his eight, five as deputy, and the stated differentiator is "strong experience of digital media" — a criterion worth testing. Was it in the person specification? How was it weighted? Was it scored consistently?

Chase the written explanation instead. Two weeks of silence is the real problem. Send a dated follow-up, reference any internal recruitment policy on feedback timescales, and copy HR.
